versions.content: function  Dem_GetEventStatus  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00003]   Std_ReturnType Dem_GetEventStatus(Dem_EventIdType EventId, Dem_UdsStatusByteType* EventStatusByte); Reads the current UDS status byte (ISO 14229-1: testFailed, testFailedThisOperationCycle, pendingDTC, confirmedDTC, testNotCompletedSinceLastClear, testFailedSinceLastClear, testNotCompletedThisOperationCycle, warningIndicatorRequested) for the event.
